normalization.method: Alpha-connected whole-pose segmentation; order complete bodies into8 rows of4, source-wide body-only calibration, nearest-neighbor scale and transparent packing.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive complete pose alpha-bounds anchor in each256px cell; upright boot soles meet this anchor
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; archived originals are untouched.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Measure white-hair crown through boot soles on a complete upright pose; lateral Blood-Scythe blade excluded. A single source-wide scale preserves real crouch and fallen-body projections.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default; turn native row3 begins left, passes through back three-quarter orientations, and ends right, chronological0123.
visualValidation.outfit: Ragna CSE2011: white spiky hair, red long coat/black straps/silver buckles, black underclothes/trousers, red-black boots, black gloves/silver details.
visualValidation.weapons: Blood-Scythe drawn as a thick gray mechanical broad sword, dark spine and red grip; one physical weapon per character, carried and physically braced.
visualValidation.handedness: Prompt fixes anatomical right Azure Grimoire and red right/green left eye; left-hand or two-hand sword carry selected for coherent choreography, not asserted exclusive canon. Small profile eyes/occluded grips cannot verify every anatomical side. Runtime P2 mirroring is an adaptation.
visualValidation.transformations: No Black Beast, monster arm, new transformation, beam or procedural body.
visualValidation.stature: 190px upright body calibration excluding lateral weapon; one source-wide scale. Actual knee flexion, leaps, low crouches, kneeling and lying KOs remain lower.
limitations: Original image-generated pixel art and adapted movement/guard choreography, not official extracted frames.
Pixel-level anatomy, sword silhouette, hand contacts, costume and heterochromia are interpreted and cannot certify1:1 canon.
Shield states use physical sword defense; source-game Barrier mechanics and exact frame timings are not reproduced.
